description: Returns the unsigned transactions to deposit USDC for lending, optionally setting per-token lending limits in the same transaction (needed before a first deposit can be lent). Check get_risk_report for each token first.

lender.description: Lender wallet that will sign; used to skip unneeded approvals and check balances

limits.description: Per-token lending limits to set in the same transaction. A first deposit needs at least one to be lent

asset.description: Token contract address on Base (preferred) or its symbol, e.g. WETH, VIRTUAL, esALB

limit_usdc.description: Max USDC to lend against this token; 0 removes it

name: build_deposit
title: Prepare a lending deposit
